title: Arranging a Luggage Transfer
transcript:
Good morning. We are walking the valley route next week and would like to send our main bags ahead each day. Your website lists a luggage service, but I wasn't sure whether individuals could book it.
Certainly. You don't need to join a group tour. We collect from registered accommodation along the route and deliver to your next overnight stop. How many people will be travelling together?
There are two of us. We have small packs for the walk and one larger suitcase between us. We will begin on Monday, staying at the Old Mill that night and moving north the next morning.
We can collect from there. Each bag needs a label showing the name of the next accommodation. Please use the labels we send, because their bright colour helps the driver distinguish our bookings from ordinary luggage.
I can do that. Do we have to wait for the driver? We were hoping to leave early on Tuesday because the first section has a steep climb and we want to avoid the afternoon heat.
You can leave the suitcase at reception before breakfast. Tell the person on duty that it is for our service. The driver has a list and will sign for the bag when it is collected.
That makes things easier. The suitcase has small wheels, and I wondered if it might be too awkward for the vehicle. We could replace it with a softer bag if that would help.
Wheels are fine. The important limit is weight. Keep the bag below eighteen kilograms so one driver can lift it safely. Sports equipment and loose walking poles need to travel with you, rather than attached to it.
Understood. We have booked the last night at a cottage instead of a hotel. The owner won't be there during the day. Would you be able to leave the suitcase inside the porch?
Only if the owner gives us written permission and confirms that the porch will be unlocked. Otherwise, we can leave it at our village office, which stays open until six in the evening.
The office sounds safer. How do I pay, and what happens if the weather is so bad that we decide to stop walking a day early and return by bus?
Payment is made online after we confirm the route. If you change your plans, call us before the morning collection. We can redirect the bag to the office, provided it has not already left.

questions.prompt: Each bag must carry one of the company’s bright ____.
questions.explanation: 公司要求使用其寄出的醒目标签。

questions.prompt: The suitcase should be left at ____ before breakfast.
questions.explanation: 工作人员要求早餐前把箱子放在前台。

questions.prompt: What restriction applies to the suitcase?
options: It must weigh less than eighteen kilograms
It must be made of soft material
questions.answer: It must weigh less than eighteen kilograms

questions.prompt: Permission is needed to leave a bag inside the ____.
questions.explanation: 门廊无人看守，须有房主书面许可。

questions.prompt: When should walkers report a change of plan?
questions.explanation: 需在早晨取件前打电话。
